item.title: Rain and snow warning to continue across Cavan today
item.description: A status yellow rain and snow warning will continue across Co Cavan today. item.title: Local councillor calls for dog owners to keep control of their pets
item.description: A local councillor is calling for dog owners to keep control of their pets. Carmel Brady raised the motion at the recent full meeting of Cavan County Council. She said there a lot of good pet owners out there, but given the time of the year it's important to not allow a dog to bother livestock. Cllr Brady said she's recieved a number of calls in relation to the issue, in particular with dogs chasing cattle. item.title: Dublin come back as Monaghan fall
item.description: Monaghan were left to count the cost of missed goal chances as Dublin scored a four point win in Croke Park. The Farney men created seven goal opportunities over the 70 minutes but failed to raise a green flag. Joe Quigley’s goal seven minutes from time, swung the game in favour of the Dubs as Monaghan have lost their opening three Allianz League games.
